categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the glass deep processing industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of processed glass products. Key product lines include household appliance glass, kitchen appliance glass, Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) glass, and glass for new energy vehicle charging stations. These products serve industries such as home appliances, photovoltaics, construction, and automotive sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced glass processing technologies including printing, coating (such as anti-fingerprint, anti-glare, anti-reflection coatings), multi-curved surface shaping, tempering, and lamination. It integrates physical and chemical surface treatments to enhance glass functionality like durability, aesthetics, and energy efficiency. Automation and laser cutting technologies have been adopted to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large domestic and international home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Electrolux, Whirlpool, Hisense, Midea, Hitachi, Panasonic, and Bosch-Siemens. The company also serves photovoltaic component manufacturers and construction firms for BIPV products, as well as new energy vehicle charging station manufacturers. The markets served include domestic China and export markets abroad.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales both domestically and internationally. It has established subsidiaries and production facilities in various Chinese regions including Jiangsu, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Hebei, and also overseas in Thailand to expand its international footprint and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork operates primarily in the midstream segment of the glass supply chain, focusing on deep processing of flat glass into specialized products. It procures raw flat glass and other materials upstream and supplies processed glass products downstream to appliance manufacturers, photovoltaic companies, and construction sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and R&D to develop high-performance, multifunctional glass products. Key R&D directions include advanced coating technologies, ultra-thin laminated glass, gradient color processing, anti-PID materials for photovoltaics, and smart glass production lines. It also focuses on automation upgrades and expanding into new markets such as smart glass and BIPV applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of processed glass products to large appliance manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company also earns income from photovoltaic power generation sales and financial investments. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented and competitive glass deep processing industry with many players. It positions itself as a technology-driven, high-quality supplier with strong R&D capabilities and established relationships with leading appliance and photovoltaic manufacturers. Its brand and technical expertise provide competitive advantages over lower-end producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, representing a 10.39% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 219.4 million, up 5.47%. Total assets reached about RMB 3.07 billion, showing steady growth. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues investing in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork offers high-value-added glass products with enhanced functionalities such as durability, aesthetics, energy efficiency, and smart features. Its differentiation lies in advanced coating technologies, customization capabilities, and integration of smart glass solutions. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and comprehensive customer service to build long-term partnerships and meet evolving market demands.
